scope: Complete final rerun of the same 225 declared method/input/limit combinations after two implementation corrections. No cases are selected by result. Initial 225 records, code, plots, verification failures, and replays are preserved under development/initial-225.

changes.issue: An outer alarm during construction of a long enumeration certificate could discard its already completed best feasible policy. The initial records remain valid but can have artificially weak fallback lower bounds.
changes.repair: Publish each completed incumbent to a caller-owned progress object. On outer interruption retain this exact original policy and its completed-book count, with the valid universal upper.

changes.issue: Decimal conversion of an extremely large rejected state count can itself hit the integer-string security limit.
changes.repair: Reject using bit-length diagnostics and a hexadecimal structured state count; never allocate the oversized table and never disable the security limit.

published_source_basis: Final source snapshot manifests in results; development results are excluded from final performance tables.
